test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined, out of which one word is incorrectly spelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The __ruins__ of many structures that still stand tall in their __granduer__ are __testimony__ to the fact that Mewar was not only the land of the __courageous__ .
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3' i.e. **'granduer'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the incorrect word is **"grandeur".**
 
• **Grandeur (भव्यता)** - The quality or state of being grand or magnificent.
 
 
• **Example**: The grandeur of the ancient palace amazed the tourists.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **granduer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other underlined words are correct in spelling.
 
 
• **Testimony (गवाही)** - Evidence or proof provided by the existence or appearance of something.
 
• **Courageous (साहसी)** - Not deterred by danger or pain; brave.
 
• **Ruins (खंडहर) **- The remains of a building, city, etc., that has been destroyed or that is in disrepair or a state of decay.
